seedExplanation: All records are fixed hand-authored examples; no sampling.

metricDefinitions.exactActionObjectAccuracy: Count with both predicted action and object equal to expected values, divided by sample count.
metricDefinitions.unsupportedInterpretationRate: False positive predicted fields divided by fields whose expected value is unknown.
metricDefinitions.correctAbstentionRate: All-unknown predictions divided by cases whose expected action and object are both unknown.
metricDefinitions.categoryAccuracy: Exact action/object accuracy computed separately for each predeclared category.
metricDefinitions.confusionCounts: Counts of predicted action/object frames per expected action/object frame.
metricDefinitions.latency: Warm full understand() latency; 5 repetitions for each held-out test item; p50 and nearest-rank p95.
